# Soulcaster

> Runtime hermetic compiler attestation interceptor generating in-toto v1.0 and SLSA v1.0 provenance with TOCTOU source defense.

## Core Capabilities
- Compiler Interception: Transparently wraps `go build`, `cargo`, `clang`, and `make`.
- TOCTOU Defense: Hashes input source trees immediately before and after compilation to detect mid-build tampering.
- Hermetic Network Isolation: Disables remote network access during compilation (`GOPROXY=off`, `GOSUMDB=off`).
- Standardized Provenance: Emits in-toto v1.0 Statements with SLSA v1.0 Provenance predicates (`<binary>.intoto.jsonl`).
- Fail-Closed Protection: Automatically deletes unattested or tampered binaries.

## CLI Usage
- `soulcaster wrap -o <out> -- <cmd>`: Wraps compiler and emits attestation file.
- `soulcaster verify --binary <path> --attestation <jsonl>`: Cryptographically validates provenance.
- `soulcaster inspect --attestation <jsonl>`: Inspects provenance materials and builder environment.

## Key Files & Paths
- Attestation Output: `<binary>.intoto.jsonl`
- Documentation: README.md & AGENTS.md
